visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair stands before a large, irregularly shaped mirror in a brightly lit boutique, filming herself with a smartphone. She wears a classic Japanese high school uniform consisting of a dark navy blazer, a white collared shirt, a red plaid bow tie, and a pleated grey plaid skirt. The background reveals racks of soft-pink and neutral-toned garments, alongside modern exposed ceiling pipes. (2) The scene transitions to the exterior of the shop, which features a prominent red sign reading "KANKO SHOP Select Square." The woman stands enthusiastically in the doorway, spreading her arms wide. The storefront displays uniforms on mannequins behind large glass windows, illuminated by warm indoor lighting. (3) A screen recording of a mobile website is displayed, showing various uniform styling options and Japanese instructional graphics for a rental service. The digital interface is clean, featuring colorful photos of models in school uniforms and structured layouts. The lighting is the flat, consistent brightness of a digital screen interface. (4) Inside the store, the camera focuses on a black price board titled "NANCHA" detailing rental packages, followed by a detailed close-up of rotating racks filled with a wide variety of plaid bow ties and striped neckties in shades of blue, red, and beige. The woman is seen in a mirror trying on a cream-colored bow tie with focused attention. (5) Her friend joins her in the mirror; both are now dressed in identical navy blazers and plaid skirts. They smile and make peace signs at the camera. Rapid cuts follow, showing neatly stacked white shirts, rows of plaid skirts in various patterns, and rows of blazers on hangers, highlighting the extensive inventory. (6) The final sequence shows the two women outdoors at a theme park, identified as Tokyo DisneySea by the iconic volcano and Jasmine's Palace in the background. They wear plush Disney-themed headbands. The lighting transitions from sunset golden tones to the warm glow of park lanterns at night, as they pose happily.
